programs.title: From Russia With Love
programs.desc: Agent 007 (Sean Connery) is back in the second installment of the James Bond series, this time battling a secret crime organization known as SPECTRE. Russians Rosa Klebb (Lotte Lenya) and Kronsteen are out to snatch a decoding device known as the Lektor, using the ravishing Tatiana (Daniela Bianchi) to lure Bond into helping them. Bond willingly travels to meet Tatiana in Istanbul, where he must rely on his wits to escape with his life in a series of deadly encounters with the enemy.

programs.title: Soul on Fire
programs.desc: A tragic accident leaves 9-year-old John O'Leary with burns covering 100% of his body. He soon embarks on a miraculous road to recovery with support from family, the community, and baseball announcer Jack Buck. Grateful for the gift of life, John becomes a motivational speaker who inspires millions of people to make the world a better place.

programs.title: No One Will Save You
programs.desc: Brynn finds solace within the walls of the home where she grew up until she's awakened one night by strange noises from unearthly intruders.

programs.title: The Carpenter's Son
programs.desc: A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

programs.title: The Bride!
programs.desc: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

programs.title: Cult Killer
programs.desc: A private investigator and his partner get drawn into a web of intrigue when they start tracking a serial killer who's targeting a wealthy family with a dark secret.

programs.title: In a Violent Nature
programs.desc: When a group of teens takes a locket from a collapsed fire tower in the woods, they unwittingly resurrect the rotting corpse of Johnny, a vengeful spirit spurred on by a horrific 60-year-old crime. The undead killer soon embarks on a bloody rampage to retrieve the stolen locket, methodically slaughtering anyone who gets in his way.

programs.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
programs.desc: The Four Horsemen and a new generation of illusionists join forces to steal the world's largest diamond from a South African mogul who heads an international crime syndicate.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Lacey is frustrated with the new party planning methods; Wanda convinces Brent and Hank to take high school tests to see who is smarter.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: The women can't get rid of Hank from a girls-only event; Brent stocks a new drink and Wanda is attracted to its cardboard promotion.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: As Bash fights for Dr. Bishop's legacy, big questions about his own future are finally answered.

programs.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programs.desc: Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.
